rows.note: Use 工人 as the all-purpose term for a person who works, especially a manual worker.

example.english: My dad has been a construction worker for decades.
example.traditional: 我阿爸做咗幾十年地盤工人。
example.jyutping: ngo5 aa3 baa4 zou6 zo2 gei2 sap6 nin4 dei6 pun4 gung1 jan4

rows.note: Use 員工 when the worker is employed by a company or organization rather than when manual labor is the focus.

example.english: Every worker at this company gets a bonus every year.
example.traditional: 呢間公司嘅員工每年都有花紅。
example.jyutping: ni1 gaan1 gung1 si1 ge3 jyun4 gung1 mui5 nin4 dou1 jau5 faa1 hung4

rows.note: Use this biological term for a nonreproductive social insect, while everyday speech often specifies the species such as an ant or bee.

example.english: A worker does not reproduce and mainly finds food and cares for the larvae.
example.traditional: 工蟲唔會繁殖，主要負責搵食同照顧幼蟲。
example.jyutping: gung1 cung4 m4 wui5 faan4 zik6 zyu2 jiu3 fu6 zaak3 wan2 sik6 tung4 ziu3 gu3 jau3 cung4

rows.note: Use this technical term for a task-running thread within a computer program.

example.english: This worker thread handles downloads in the background.
example.traditional: 呢個工作執行緒會喺背景處理下載。
example.jyutping: ni1 go3 gung1 zok3 zap1 hang4 seoi5 wui5 hai2 bui3 ging2 cyu5 lei5 haa6 zoi3
